t_advice_summary_textbox.text: there are different sets of gnomes but they always appear in the same pairs, they send you to either a bright forest or a gloomy forest and you have to choose the one with the most mushrooms. they specificaly say that the shape of the mushroom is irrelevant

vb_textbox.text: i found that if i just mostly stuck to the left hand side i got mushrooms most of the time, i switched it about a few times but just mostly went with the left, i ended up with over 3000 mushrooms this way, i have no idea if that is a lot or not. colour, shape doesnt seem to make any difference, the person before me said it was to do with which colour gnome sent you to which colour basket but i didnt find any difference so i just stuck with the left. helps when you get tired and your nose itches. Good Luck!!
